verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI review docs explicitly claim a 'codebase-aware AI code review agent' (docs-16) and Graphite Chat can 'find related files, understand dependencies, and get context from other PRs without switching tabs' (docs-15) plus explain code sections and highlight issues with repo context (docs-21), directly supporting whole-repo-aware review beyond the diff. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation that reviews actually surface call sites and existing conventions (not just vendor claims), and no explicit mention of 'existing conventions' detection.
